ordering_fields.event_time: physical/domain event time in the stream's declared clock basis
ordering_fields.acquisition_time: instrument acquisition time in the same declared basis
ordering_fields.collector_receipt_time_unix: collector receipt wall-clock time; never substitutes for event/acquisition time
ordering_fields.display_timezone: presentation metadata only; never the ordering authority

rules: A stream is scoped by instrument, channel, firmware/configuration, clock domain, boot epoch and stream ID.
Monotonic values are comparable only inside their exact clock domain and boot epoch.
A reboot, counter reset or wrap creates a new boot epoch; it never silently reuses a sequence namespace.
Exact duplicate sample ID/sequence/digest is idempotent; same identity or sequence with conflicting content is rejected.
Missing sequence intervals remain gaps; no zero fill or interpolation is permitted by this contract.
Out-of-order delivery is retained and may be reconciled only within the declared bounded reorder window.
Clock mapping is versioned, receipt-bound, validity-bounded and uncertainty-qualified when cross-domain correlation is required.
Local timezone and DST are presentation concerns; unsupported local-wall-clock-only input is non-comparable.
Symtropy availability-event ticks are not physical measurement clock values.
